name: Hab Tubes
desc: contains a partially constructed network of Domain-era metallo-ceramic habitation tubes knitted throughout the surface and subterranean crust, making this planet significantly less hostile to human habitation.

name: Hab Tubes
desc: contains an extensive network of Domain-era habitation tubes intertwined with the surface and atmosphere. The ancient orbital automata cloud remains active, relentlessly expanding the construction and posing a severe hazard to colonists.
